findings.evidence: code/TauCeti/Algebra/AlgebraicGroup/Tangent/Basic.lean:635 `lemma algEquivSelf_derivation_smul_apply (b) (d) (a) : algEquivSelf R A B ((b • d) a) = b * algEquivSelf R A B (d a)`, whose own proof comments say the `rfl` there 'isolates the necessary coefficient-synonym reduction'; it is applied in this style at GeneralLinear/Tangent.lean:119.
findings.fix: Rewrite both steps with `Tangent.Basic`'s `algEquivSelf_derivation_smul_apply b d _` (and its symm at the last step); the calc then collapses to two transport steps.
findings.issue: `derivationCompLinear.map_smul'` is a 27-line calc whose steps at lines 200-204 and 211-214 are exactly the existing public lemma `algEquivSelf_derivation_smul_apply`, but are discharged by bare undocumented `rfl` after two `algEquivSelf_apply` rewrites. That lemma was written to isolate this coefficient-synonym reduction and is already used that way elsewhere.

Line 206: `simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag_apply]` (Mathlib itself uses `simp [trace]`). findings.evidence: Line 68 leaves `d ↑(determinantGroupLike R n) = 0` from the span generator `↑(determinantGroupLike R n) - 1` (SpecialLinear/Basic.lean:160 `definingHopfIdeal_toIdeal`); the explicit trailing `rfl` shows `rw`'s own reflexivity check did not close it.

findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Action/Defs.lean:74 `lemma smul_eq_mul {α} [Mul α] (a b : α) : a • b = a * b`.
findings.fix: Replace both `change`s with `rw [smul_eq_mul]` (or `simp only [smul_eq_mul]`) so the step is an explicit rewrite rather than a defeq assertion.
findings.issue: In the relocated `derivationVanishingIdeal`, the two `change` steps (lines 145, 148) are justified by 'An ideal's scalar action is multiplication', which is precisely the content of the public `smul_eq_mul`.

summary: Several new proofs re-derive by bare `rfl`/`change` facts for which a public lemma already exists (notably `algEquivSelf_derivation_smul_apply`, `Matrix.add_apply`/`smul_apply`, `Matrix.diag_apply`, `TrivSqZeroExt.fst_inl`, `smul_eq_mul`), and the comments justifying those `change` steps state that no equation lemma exists when the same proof uses one two lines later. Replace the undocumented defeq steps with the available rewrites.
